summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV filed a Form 6-K reporting repurchases of 77,667 ordinary shares between June 15-19, 2026, at an average price of €24.6586 per share, totaling €1.92 million. The buyback is part of a share repurchase program announced on June 9, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The repurchases were executed on Euronext (EXNT). As of June 19, Lakefront holds 116,204 treasury shares. What to watch: ongoing open-market repurchases under the program's announced framework, with impact on share count and potential support for stock price.
